title: Rav Chana Petora’ah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Chullin 54b he said: “Bar Nafcha (possibly Rabbi Yochanan, as in Bava Metzia 85b) was standing above me, and he asked me for Kurdinian dinars. I wished to rise before him, but he did not let me; he said to me, ‘Sit, my son, sit,’” etc.

notes.text: The William Davidson digital Chullin 54b fully writes Rabbi Chana Petora’ah, whereas Hyman’s heading fully writes Rav; the source title is retained alongside the witness difference. Vilna Rashi’s digital gloss says he was a money changer with many coins before him. The possible identification of Bar Nafcha with Rabbi Yochanan remains Hyman’s conjecture.
The consulted Chullin text has Rabbi and a singular dinar, beside Hyman’s Rav and plural dinars. Bava Metzia 85b supplies the context for Hyman’s suggested identification.
